title: Speaking — Visiting libraries
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on visiting libraries.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
When did you last use a library or reading room?
What would make you visit a library more often?

part2.topic: Describe a library or study space where you felt comfortable.
part2.closing: and explain why you found it easy to concentrate there.

questions: What role can libraries play beyond lending books?
Should libraries prioritise quiet study spaces or social activities?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to visiting libraries?
